week_focus: This closes the food unit. Use actual Week 2 notes, the plan and any checked food-only photo. No food is needed and no week-old food is tasted. A photo cannot prove taste. If taste was not tried or recorded, mark it not assessed. Use sensory words only for an actual experience or clearly labelled adult model. The Week 1 invented model costs 140p for one portion, with 60p left from 200p. A two-portion batch costing 280p is 140p each; an already per-portion figure is not divided again. Actual substitutions need their actual recorded costs. Review the balanced eating pattern over the day or week and choose one improvement.
evidence_rule: Actual pupil choices, work, support, dates and comments only. Adult models, photo descriptions and simulations are labelled honestly. Missing work or unperformed practical actions stay visible. A tick records weekly evidence, not award completion.
